turns.instruction:
Build the industrial frame, span 24 m and height 12 m. Roof gravity is 36 kN/m. The right column top has crane +X 10 kN and -Z 98 kN; the left column has a connected node at Z=6 m with equipment +X 14 kN. Report global Ux and Uz at the highest-story rightmost beam-column joint, and global support moment My and vertical reaction Fz at the left base, for every listed case and combination.
Use the stated OpenSees engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable . Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.

The crane load is to increase by 20%, but it has not yet been decided whether this applies to both components or only the vertical component. Ask me to confirm the scope before updating or analysing the frame.

Increase only the right-top vertical crane force from 98 to 117.6 kN downward. Keep its +X 10 kN, the separate left equipment +X 14 kN, and roof 36 kN/m unchanged. Recompute. Report global Ux and Uz at the highest-story rightmost beam-column joint, and global support moment My and vertical reaction Fz at the left base, for every listed case and combination.
